## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Preserve existing fingerprints during refresh before merge because refreshing a hand-edited tracked file makes verification accept the edit.

## Changes
The pull request adds helpers to refresh manifest fingerprints and register previously unlisted files, with tests covering registration and empty inputs. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Preserve existing fingerprints during refresh — When `tracked.txt` is hand-edited and included in `names`, you overwrite its original digest with the edited file’s digest. Consequently, `verify` returns `True` despite the edit; `register_new_files` already guards against this overwrite. — Refreshing after adding files can erase evidence of edits to tracked content and falsely report that content as intact.
